Lazard — Financial Advisory Analyst, Brussels (graduate start 2025)
Lazard's Brussels office advises Belgian and European corporates, families and financial sponsors on M&A, restructuring and capital markets.
As an Analyst you will build financial models (DCF, LBO, comparable companies and precedent transactions), prepare pitch books and information memoranda, run data rooms and support senior bankers throughout live transactions.
Requirements:
- Master's degree in business engineering, economics, finance or similar, graduating in 2025 with excellent results
- At least one internship in M&A, corporate finance, transaction services or private equity
- Strong financial modelling and valuation skills; advanced Excel and PowerPoint
- Fluent in English and Dutch or French; the third language is a plus
- Attention to detail and ability to work long hours in a small team
We offer a structured analyst training programme in London and exposure to cross-border mandates.
